_why: Real desktop sessions exposed rejected documented key names, incomplete observations, unstable window ordinals and misleading execution errors. These cases pin the supported behavior independently of any other implementation.

inputState.pointerChordDelivery: same system stream for down and up

windowsInput._why: Extended and Unicode encodings may share scan values without identifying the same held key.
windowsInput.keypadEqual: native keypad mapping or explicit unsupported layout

appStateDiff._why: Repeated observations stay comparable without hiding first-look content.
appStateDiff.default: diff from the state the model was last shown

scrollTarget._why: Content without an accessible element still scrolls at an observed point.

paste._why: Large or formatted text must not depend on typing keystrokes, and the user's clipboard stays theirs.

audioRecording._why: System output capture must stay bounded, single-active and volume-neutral.
audioRecording.retrieval: stop returns an audio content block

screenshotImage._why: Every turn ships a fresh frame; lossy encoding keeps repeated payloads small while the encoded geometry must still match the declared coordinate mapping.

desktopSurface._why: The full-desktop surface stitches every visible display into one observation and drives global input; its tool list, coordinate mapping, guard wording and sticky cleanup close are contract, not implementation detail.
desktopSurface.platform: The full desktop surface is available only on Windows
desktopSurface.coordinateSpace: screenshot pixels mapped onto the virtual desktop bounds

errors.turnGate: Call get_desktop_screenshot in this assistant turn before sending input
errors.identityRequired: Desktop input needs a foreground application; focus one and call get_desktop_screenshot again
errors.startTwice: drag handle can only be started once
errors.moveWithoutStart: drag handle must be started before moving
errors.endWithoutStart: drag handle must be started before ending
errors.closed: The desktop input session is closed after a failed cleanup; stop and report the error
errors.friendTask: Friend tasks cannot control the full desktop

appGuidance._why: First-visit guidance is a delivery contract: app know-how must reach the model exactly once per session on the first observation of that app, with a stable wire format.
appGuidance.delivery: prefix of the first observation text per app per session

emergencyStop._why: A physical Escape press is the person's takeover: it must stop the attributed turn with its own wording, never be triggerable by input the helper posted itself, and degrade to a logged no-watch when the OS refuses the listener.

stopMessages.macos: This application session has been explicitly stopped by the user for this turn. Stop your work and send a final message noting they stopped the session and you're ready to continue if they want you to. Computer Use can be used again in the next assistant turn.
stopMessages.windows: Computer Use was stopped by the user with the physical Escape key. Stop your work, do not call further Computer Use tools in this turn, and send a final message noting that the user stopped Computer Use.

emergencyStop.turnScoped: the stopped turn refuses every later call and aborts in-flight ones with the stop wording unwrapped; the next turn starts clean
